description:
Hi, 

 I hope this mail finds you in best of your spirits and health!
 

 My name is Sandeep, I am from Deegit Inc. I have job opening with my client, details are below please let me know if you are suitable and looking for new projects.
 

 Salesforce Developer 
 San Francisco, CA 
 12 Months 
 

 We need two or three high quality consultants.
 Great communication skills, very strong technically and presentable.
 

 5+ years of hands-on design and development experience with the salesforce.com API and experience with hands-on APEX and Visualforce development.
 Experience in designing solutions within the Salesforce.com platform.
 Ability to effectively communicate technical issues and resolve problems at all levels of the organization both internally and externally.
 Solid understanding of data structures, data modeling, & database schema is preferred
 Proven ability to design and optimize business processes and to integrate business processes across disparate systems.
 Proficient with DataLoader and/or other relevant administration tools
 Experience with Informatica (Cloud or Powercenter) is a major plus
 Interface with APTTUS and SAP (good to have)
 Expected Deliverables/Responsibilities:
 

 Strong Salesforce technical knowledge with experience in writing Apex Classes/ Triggers/ VF Pages/ Web-services (SOAP or REST API)
 Hands- on knowledge in Salesforce.com Sales Cloud or Service Cloud Administration and Configuration
 Completion of several Salesforce.com implementation projects in development/ technical roles.
 Ability to define and deliver custom Force.com enterprise applications.
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills
 Analytical and problem solving abilities
 Ability to participate in or facilitate workshops
 Exposure to ITIL methodology of service management
 


 Looking for someone who can work on w2 contract.

 Strong Salesforce technical knowledge with experience in writing Apex Classes/ Triggers/ VF Pages/ Web-services (SOAP or REST API)
 Hands- on knowledge in Salesforce.com Sales Cloud or Service Cloud Administration and Configuration
 Completion of several Salesforce.com implementation projects in development/ technical roles.
 Ability to define and deliver custom Force.com enterprise applications.
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills
 Analytical and problem solving abilities
 Ability to participate in or facilitate workshops
 Exposure to ITIL methodology of service management
